items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Rapid City
items.description: Rapid City’s Finance Office handles city business licenses for specified regulated activities, including adult-oriented businesses, central-station services, ice-cream vendors, pawn or secondhand businesses, refuse hauling, security, sidewalk vending, taxis, transportation networks, and alcohol-related businesses; other businesses are directed to the South Dakota Department of Revenue for state licensing.
